categories_thin: Bicycle shops: no independent bike shop found inside the zone after a Route 27 and Georges Rd sweep.
Independent hardware stores: none found; the township's hardware demand is served by Home Depot (Monmouth Junction) and chain auto parts stores, which are excluded.
Toy / hobby / music-instrument retail: only very small or home-based listings, so almost nothing eligible.

Photography studios: the listings found (Shotwell Productions, Darnell Gourdine Photography, Laura Lynn Photography) are home-based businesses at residential addresses, excluded under the no-home-address rule.

Pet grooming: apart from All Good Dogs, the groomers found either sit inside a veterinary hospital outside this zone (Kendall Park Pet Care, Princeton address) or are home-based (Pawpals Paradise, residential address).
Roofing: only three qualifying contractors surfaced for South Brunswick itself; most results for 'Monmouth Junction roofers' are out-of-town contractors using service-area pages.
Veterinarians, optometrists, chiropractors and med spas were not swept in this revision; they belong to group B, which this zone (group D) does not cover.
caveats: Group B and C entries (dentists, physical therapy, salons, nail salons, martial arts, auto repair, plumbing, roofing) were added in this revision only because the verifier counted them as missing coverage. They are correctly labelled group B/C; if another mapper owns those groups for South Brunswick, de-duplicate against that file.

Removed this revision: Stanworth School (9 Stanworth Rd - one directory says the location has closed, no current source confirms it operates, and its old domain no longer serves the school's site), LTD Nursery and Landscaping (out of zone - a Bernardsville company with a Dayton service-area page), Guidepost Montessori at Kendall Park (national chain), Pierre's Banquets (food service), Gun Vault USA (no evidence of a storefront at 3570 NJ-27; only online-retail and aggregator listings), Dayton's 'Best After School Program' (site would not load; no independent confirmation), Kendall Park Pet Care Grooming (4222 Route 27, Princeton - a Franklin-side address, not a South Brunswick business).

Corrected this revision: Amato's address and phone now follow the state nursery registry; Montessori Academy and Learning Center merged into The Promissory Montessori; websites blanked for Montessori Children's World and Fusion King Welding (dead domains); blanks filled for Kalanjali, Kids First Montessori, The Sapling School, Smokey Cloud and Fashion Waves.

Added this revision after confirming them on pages: The Dance Collective NJ, Crossroads Nursery, Sign N Print Pros, Carkuff's Patio and Garden Center, Windsor-Brunswick Driving Academy, plus the group B/C entries listed above.

Chain/franchise exclusions made: Bright Horizons, KinderCare, The Learning Experience, The Goddard School of Dayton, Kumon (Dayton and Kendall Park), Genie Academy, Board & Brush, Massage LuXe, Re/Max Diamond Realtors, Travel Leaders (franchise network), Champions at Dayton Campus, The UPS Store, Mattress by Appointment, Data Doctors, Camp Bow Wow, Days Inn, Extra Space Storage, Public Storage, Home Depot, CVS/M&T/OceanFirst/Magyar Bank and brand car dealers. Party Fair is listed but flagged as a possible franchise.
Westminster Conservatory of Music (Monmouth Junction) excluded as a university-run program (Rider University).

Directory-only entries needing confirmation: Smokey Cloud, Fine Paints/Benjamin Moore, Middlesex Gutter Supply, Carter Cleaners, Star of David Memorial Chapel, American Dentistry, Nail Spa, Fit Kicks Martial Arts, Navarro Family Roofing, Little Learners, Dubrow's, Montessori Children's World.

Kingston businesses (Rider Furniture, The New School for Music Study) are inside South Brunswick Township but carry Kingston/Princeton ZIPs; both are roughly 5 miles from central Milltown and inside the 10-mile radius.
Several phones are the published office line of a firm headquartered elsewhere (e.g. Patriot Transport).
data_gaps: Google Maps, Yelp, YellowPages, BBB, Manta and chamberofcommerce.com largely blocked automated access (bot checks/403), and Overpass/OSM timed out, so coverage relies on Bing-derived street directories, state registries, trade directories and business websites. Some owner-operated shops on Route 27 and Georges Rd are still likely missing.
No reliable tenant list for the Dayton/Stouts Ln/Herrod Blvd industrial parks; the logistics entries are the ones with public pages.

Street addresses not published where I could see them: Logistics Plus Dayton, East Coast Warehouse Dayton, Dean Plumbing, Fairway Exteriors, B2Z Dance School, Windsor-Brunswick Driving Academy (address taken from its search listing).

Several establishments in the Town Place centre (American Dentistry, Nail Spa, Fit Kicks Martial Arts) come only from the landlord broker's 2026 co-tenant list, which gives no suite numbers or phones.
Stanworth School and the Dayton after-school listing were dropped rather than confirmed because no phone check was possible under the read-only, no-contact rules.
Shopify-hosted sites (Better Home) and several Wix sites (dental practices) did not expose address/phone in the page text I extracted; those fields come from map/directory listings instead.
